scoring: saved pilot standardized sliced W2 with 512 frozen projections; standardized mean and covariance error against fresh independent validated full-data HMC
interpretation_rules: Compare shared geometry and batch at matched h=0.3 to isolate the CV order mechanism.
Compare CV2 h=0.3 with CV1 h=0.1 for a method-specific step-size cost check, without calling it a matched-h mechanism contrast.
Report failure to mix at the fixed cap; do not extend based on intermediate outcomes.
The identity and full-Hessian arms use different h scales and their contrast is a calibrated-regime geometry comparison, not a same-h controlled effect.
HMC-to-HMC SW2 is a resolution indicator, not a lower bound; do not assert K_needed.
Existing adaptive diagonal pCV1/pCV2 remain secondary historical diagnostics because their metrics evolve separately; they are not relabeled as shared-geometry controls.
cost_scope: Fresh anchor, CV full gradient, CV2 Hessian, full-Hessian inverse/factorization when applicable, plus all 512-replica transitions; HMC scoring is external evaluation cost.
timing: sequential one-BLAS-thread ensembles, setup charged once per collection
